nodes.text:
A six-month-old baby was diagnosed with Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) at Hiranandani Hospital in Mumbai on January 8. Admitted on January 1 with severe cough, chest tightness, and low oxygen levels, the infection was confirmed via a rapid PCR test.
